title: Venice Image
description: Tools for generating images using the Venice AI API.

venice_image_vision.title: Image Vision
venice_image_vision.description: Describes an image provided via URL using the Venice AI API. Ideal for understanding the content of an existing image

venice_image_enhance.title: Image Enhance
venice_image_enhance.description: Tool for **Enhance** (modifying specific areas of) an existing image using a selected image model via Venice AI

venice_image_upscale.title: Image Upscale
venice_image_upscale.description: Upscale an existing image by 2x or 4x using Venice AI.

venice_image_generation_flux_dev.title: Image Generation (Flux-Dev)
venice_image_generation_flux_dev.description: Generate images using Venice AI's Flux Dev model (research, art workflows).

venice_image_generation_flux_dev_uncenso.title: Image Generation (Flux-Dev-Uncensored)
venice_image_generation_flux_dev_uncenso.description: Generate images using the uncensored Flux Dev model (unrestricted, NSFW).

venice_image_generation_venice_sd35.title: Image Generation (Venice SD3.5)
venice_image_generation_venice_sd35.description: Generate images using Stability AI's SD 3.5 Large (art, design).

venice_image_generation_fluently_xl.title: Image Generation (Fluently-XL)
venice_image_generation_fluently_xl.description: Generate images using Fluently-XL (aesthetics, lighting, realism).

venice_image_generation_lustify_sdxl.title: Image Generation (Lustify-SDXL)
venice_image_generation_lustify_sdxl.description: Generate images using Lustify SDXL (photorealistic, focus on NSFW).

venice_image_generation_pony_realism.title: Image Generation (Pony-Realism)
venice_image_generation_pony_realism.description: Generate images using Pony Realism (high-detail, realistic, anime/characters).

venice_image_generation_stable_diffusion.title: Image Generation (Stable Diffusion 3.5 - Alt ID)
venice_image_generation_stable_diffusion.description: Generate images using Stability AI's SD 3.5 Large (alternative API ID).
